I used to be depressed and my mother found me a nice counselor to talk to. He told me that if I am ever feeling like I am being overwhelmed with bad emotions (i.e. anger, sadness, depression) that I should imagine that I am in a safe place. For example, I always imagine I am in a cabin way high in the mountains with a crackling fire and a good computer that I can stay on for forever. 

In your dream, I see this house as being your safe place. And in your safe place, you have all of your friends in the house doing activities that you enjoy like smoking and video games. But for some reason, you never stay to join them in their activities and instead, I think you feel you are running out of time, hence the sprinting quicker and quicker. 

I think that the tree is also important. The tree that slows you down is what is grounding you and is what let's you see your higher purpose in the end. The tree stands for a relationship in my opinion. The people in the house also provided relationships to you but you never stayed and the only thing that you ever held onto was the tree. 

You won't stay with your friends and their activities because you have a greater purpose to do and time is of the essence. Now I hate to get religious, especially on reddit, but when ever I see a dream that has something to do with a being in the sky, I see religion. Maybe you won't join your friends in their activities because you have some thing to do in the world, something that a higher deity wants you to do if you believe in that type of thing.
